'''Virtual Set 21''' is a Players Committee virtual expansion from the 2014 Reset onward. It was released 18 June 2023. These are not Decipher cards.

Current virtual cards are maintained by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee. Printable slips are published with each set.

== Design ==
The Light Side Clone Army objective [[Hunt For The Droid General / He's A Coward (Errata)|Hunt For The Droid General]] was built by a Players Committee design pod. That pod included Rules Advocate [[Greg Zinn]], Technology Advocate Adam Fletcher and [[Wayne Cullen]]. Clones had been a frequent request in player surveys, and the pod was asked to cover the period from the Battle of Geonosis to Grievous's death on Utapau.<ref name="aotd">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lmnqre87HWo&t=990s Star Wars CCG - Holotheatre S4 E22 - Attack of the Designers (full episode)] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015174217/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lmnqre87HWo&t=990s Internet Archive], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 19 June 2023), at 16:30. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/Season 4 Episode 22 transcript]].</ref> Geonosis and Christophsis were chosen as the first two major Clone Wars battles. They are the only systems with a second battle, Geonosis from the films and Christophsis from ''The Clone Wars''. Diamond sites let the deck fight on any system.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lmnqre87HWo&t=2080s Star Wars CCG - Holotheatre S4 E22 - Attack of the Designers (full episode)] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015174217/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lmnqre87HWo&t=2080s Internet Archive], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 19 June 2023), at 34:40. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/Season 4 Episode 22 transcript]].</ref>
